notes: Append-only manifest of prompt optimization runs. Each new optimization pass appends one entry to `entries`; existing entries are never modified or reordered. The diff between an entry's `version_hash`/`parent_hash` and its `optimizer_config` represents what the optimizer changed relative to the previous run. To add a run: append a new entry, set its `parent_hash` to the previous entry's `version_hash`, and compute `version_hash` over the new prompt content.

optimizer_config.rationale: Pivoted Zorva to Canada-first / Alberta Health focus. Cleaned val_ca.json gold (5 false-positive dx_linkage findings removed, 3 missed findings added, 1 US modifier leak fixed). v12 prompt: AHCIP-only guidance with 7 AHCIP pattern sections (dx_linkage, non_insured_service, em_level distinction, referring_practitioner_id, global_window without -24, psychotherapy_time, telehealth, lab-vs-imaging, same_day_conflict, CMGP). 7 few-shot examples vs v11's 5. Drops US modifier -24 (Alberta has none). 10539 chars, mean 49.7s p95 119.1s, 0 errors.
